title: Android Developer
description:
ENGINEERING 
 OPPORTUNITIES Android Application Engineer Connectivity and Audio **Suggested experience:
 **4+ years of Android development. Project allocation: May
 begin part-time during hardware feasibility; full-time during integration as
 host interfaces stabilize. About the project We are developing an Android-based communication system for
 sensor and control messages and audio over Wi-Fi HaLow and DECT NR+. The
 project combines radio hardware, embedded firmware and Android software to
 support controlled radio switching and reliable recovery. The phone platform
 and host interfaces will be confirmed through feasibility and hardware
 validation. Your role Extend the existing Android reference application into a
 reliable user experience for control and audio across selectable HaLow and NR+
 transports. Key responsibilities 
 Maintain and extend the shared Java application;
 use Kotlin where appropriate to the agreed architecture. 
 Implement transport adapters behind a shared
 application interface, coordinating radio selection through the platform
 controller. 
 Support explicit network/socket binding or the
 selected Nordic host interface without unintended fallback. 
 Implement microphone capture, packetization,
 bounded buffering and automatic recovery after a radio transition. 
 Define pending-command behavior with request
 IDs, expiry, deduplication/reconciliation and clear status reporting. 
 Handle permission denial, device disconnects,
 activity lifecycle changes and interrupted transitions. 
 Add IPv6 or other transport support where
 required by the chosen NR+ integration. 
 Integrate native C/C++ transport or audio
 libraries through the Android NDK and JNI where needed, with clear ownership of
 buffers, threads and resource lifetimes. 
 Maintain Gradle/CMake native builds and
 troubleshoot native crashes, ABI compatibility and library packaging. Required skills 
 Java/Kotlin, Android lifecycle, permissions,
 concurrency and Gradle. 
 Hands-on Android NDK, JNI and C/C++ development,
 including native memory management, threading and debugging. 
 CMake, Gradle native integration, Clang/LLVM
 cross-compilation and Android ABI/shared-library packaging. 
 Working knowledge of GCC toolchains and GNU Make
 builds for existing native and embedded codebases. 
 Android networking, sockets and network
 selection. 
 AudioRecord, PCM data handling and resource
 cleanup. 
 State-driven UI and asynchronous error handling. 
 Device-level debugging using adb, logcat and
 network diagnostics. Preferred skills 
 USB host/serial integration, IPv6 and
 communication with embedded accessories. 
 Codec integration, jitter buffering and
 real-time audio troubleshooting. 
 Experience maintaining ndk-build projects using
 Android.mk and Application.mk. GCC knowledge supports work with existing native and
 embedded codebases; Android NDK builds use the applicable Clang/LLVM toolchain. Expected outcomes A shared application that supports both transports, resumes
 automatically after switching, avoids duplicate control execution through
 agreed protocol semantics, and clearly reports connection and audio state.

Key Skills: Java,C++,Kotlin,CMake ,C,JNI,Android NDK,Cmake

title: Junior Website Administrator / CMS Content Executive
description:
Junior Website Administrator / CMS Content Executive 
 Company: WEBPRO UK Digital Agency
 Location: Remote India
 Job Type: Full-time, initial 3-month contract with potential for ongoing work
 Salary: 25,000-30,000 per month, depending on experience
 Experience: 1-3 years preferred 
 About WEBPRO 
 WEBPRO is an established UK-based digital agency providing website development, hosting, SEO and digital marketing services to businesses across the UK. 
 We manage a large portfolio of client websites and develop our own website management tools and modules. 
 We are looking for a reliable, organised and detail-oriented individual to join our team and assist with website administration, content migration and other structured website tasks. 
 This is not a software development position. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with websites, following processes, paying attention to detail and completing tasks accurately. 
 The Role 
 You will initially work on two major projects across our existing client websites. 
 Project 1 Website Forms Migration 
 Recreate existing website forms using our new Forms Module. Configure form fields, labels, settings and basic styling. Add supplied embed code to website pages. Check that forms display correctly and function as expected. Test form submissions and notifications. Disable the old forms once the new versions have been successfully tested. Record completed work and move on to the next website. 
 Project 2 Blog Content Migration 
 Set up blogs using our new Blog Widget. Transfer existing blog posts, images and other content. Maintain content formatting and existing information. Configure and add the new Blog Widget to websites. Test the new blog pages, links and presentation. Check that existing URLs are preserved or flag changes requiring technical assistance. Disable the previous blog functionality once the migration has been verified. 
 Other Responsibilities 
 As projects progress, you may also assist with: 
 Updating website pages and content. Uploading and organising images and documents. Moving information between website systems. Website content checks and corrections. Checking links, formatting and page layouts. Completing other structured website administration tasks. Maintaining accurate records of work completed. 
 Full training will be provided on WEBPRO's own modules and procedures. 
 Skills and Experience 
 Essential: 
 Good general computer skills and confidence working with web-based applications. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Experience updating website content through a CMS or similar administration interface. Good written English and communication skills. Ability to follow instructions and repeat processes consistently. Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks. Comfortable working with spreadsheets and task management systems. Willingness to learn new systems and tools. 
 Desirable: 
 Experience with Drupal, WordPress or another content management system. Basic understanding of HTML. Experience using website forms, content editors or page builders. Previous website content migration or administration experience. Basic understanding of website testing and quality assurance. 
 You do not need to be a PHP developer or have advanced programming knowledge. 
 The Person We Are Looking For 
 We are particularly interested in someone who: 
 Takes pride in completing work correctly. Is patient and comfortable with detailed, repetitive tasks. Checks their own work rather than relying on others to find mistakes. Can identify when something does not look right and ask for guidance. Is dependable, focused and well organised. Enjoys completing tasks and moving efficiently on to the next assignment. 
 Accuracy, reliability and attitude are more important to us than qualifications or extensive technical experience. 
 What We Offer 
 Remote working from India. Regular work with an established UK digital agency. Training on our website management systems. Clear instructions and structured project assignments. Support from our experienced development team. Exposure to a variety of websites and digital platforms. Opportunity for a longer-term working relationship depending on performance and business requirements. 
 The position will initially be offered on a three-month contract, with the possibility of extension. 
 How to Apply 
 Please submit your CV through Naukri, together with a brief explanation of your experience working with websites, content management systems or similar online administration tools. 
 Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short practical assessment to demonstrate their attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.

title: Power Platform Technical Lead (Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse)
description:
Role: Power Platform Technical Lead Location: Remote Shift Hours: 1400 to 2300 hours IST  Job Type: Full-time Experience: 8+ years 


 Role Purpose The Power Platform Technical Lead is the senior technical authority for Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), Dataverse and the wider Power Platform. The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, defining standards, reviewing code, owning the ALM model and ensuring that everything we build on the platform is scalable, secure and production-ready. The Lead works closely with the Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Solution Architects and the IT Applications Developer team. 
 Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership in D365 & Power Platform Act as technical authority for Dynamics 365 CE and Power Platform solutions, owning architecture decisions, design patterns and non-functional requirements. Mentor IT Applications Developers and citizen makers; raise the technical bar through coaching, design reviews and pairing. Translate business requirements into well-architected Dataverse data models, app designs and integration patterns. Solution Management with Native Git Own the Dataverse Git integration strategy: branch model, solution segmentation, folder structure, commit hygiene and developer onboarding. Maintain repository standards in Azure DevOps Repos (branch policies, PR templates, required reviewers, build validation). Enforce solution layering, managed-properties discipline and unmanaged-customisation block policies. 
 Solution Deployment & Versioning Design and operate deployments through native Power Platform Pipelines (in PPAC) and complementary Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines for code-first artefacts. Define environment strategy (Dev / Build / Test / UAT / Pre-Prod / Prod) and the promotion path for each solution stream. Govern release versioning, release notes (incl. Copilot-assisted generation), approval gates and hotfix workflows. 
 Flow & Agent Management Provide design and run-time governance for Cloud Flows, Desktop Flows and Copilot/agent flows: connection references, environment variables, error handling, performance, throttling. Define standards for service-principal-owned flows, sharing models and DLP-compliant connector usage. 
 Infrastructure as Code Terraform Maintain Terraform modules for the Azure resources that support Power Platform (resource groups, service principals, Key Vaults, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Storage, App Insights). Review and approve Terraform pull requests; enforce state-management and module-versioning standards. Dynamics CRM Plugins & Extensibility Design, review and maintain Dataverse plugins, custom APIs, custom workflow activities and PCF components in C#/.NET. Set standards for plugin performance (transactions, depth, ILogger, tracing service) and review for security risk. 
 Code Review Standards Be the named code reviewer for high-impact Power Platform, Dataverse and Azure-adjacent changes. Author and continuously improve coding standards covering C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Power Fx, Dataverse plugins and Logic Apps. Champion the use of solution checker, Power Platform CLI, ESLint/Prettier and SonarCloud. D365 Security Management & Configuration Design Dataverse security roles, business units, teams, field-level security and hierarchy security. Govern security-role version control through solutions and ensure audit-grade traceability of permission changes. Azure Foundations Resource Groups: define naming, tagging and access conventions; review RG-level RBAC. Service Principals: govern lifecycle (creation, secret/cert rotation, expiry monitoring) and least-privilege assignments. Key Vault: manage secret storage standards, access policies / RBAC, integration with Logic Apps, Functions, ADO and Power Platform connection references. 
 Pipeline Deployment for Logic Apps Azure Functions Own the CI/CD pipelines for Logic Apps (Standard and Consumption) and Azure Functions used as Dataverse extensions or integration glue. Define artefact, slot-swap and parameterisation strategy across environments. Integration Tooling Use Postman and SoapUI to design, document and regression-test REST/SOAP integrations to/from Dataverse, 
 F&O and third-party systems. Maintain shared collections and environments for the developer team. Programming Languages C# (.NET 8+) plugins, custom APIs, Azure Functions. TypeScript / JavaScript client-side scripts, PCF components, Logic Apps inline code. Power Fx formula standards across canvas apps and Power Automate. 
 Use of AI Use GitHub Copilot, Copilot in Power Apps / Power Automate / Power Pages and Copilot Studio to accelerate delivery and standardise patterns. Govern responsible AI use data handling, prompt patterns, model selection and review of AI-generated code before merge. Identify opportunities to deploy Copilot Studio agents for internal user support and internal IT operations. 
 Essential Skills & Experience 6+ years in the Microsoft Dynamics CRM / Dataverse ecosystem, with at least 2 years in a lead or senior engineering role. Deep, hands-on experience with Dataverse data modelling, security and extensibility. Production experience with native Power Platform Pipelines and Dataverse Git integration. Strong C# / .NET, TypeScript and Power Fx; comfortable in both pro-code and low-code stacks. Demonstrable Azure experience: Resource Groups, RBAC, Service Principals, Key Vault, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, App Insights. 
 Hands-on Terraform for the supporting Azure footprint. Experience leading code reviews and authoring engineering standards. Proficient with Postman and SoapUI for integration testing. 
 Desirable Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600). Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400). Experience with Dual Write between F&O and Dataverse. Exposure to Copilot Studio and Microsoft AI Builder. Experience in a regulated, multi-country enterprise.

Key Skills: Azure Devops,Application,Dynamics,Azure Logic Apps,C#,Plugins,Microsoft Azure,Azure Functions
